prompts.prompt: Create an ORIGINAL pixel game vegetation sprite sheet, using the attached WorldBox screenshot ONLY as the precise visual style and overhead camera reference. Do not crop or extract sprites from it. This is deliberately LOW resolution art, each object designed on a 32 by 40 pixel grid then enlarged with nearest-neighbor. Clean cohesive chunky pixel clusters. Eight individual sprites in an exact 4 columns by 2 rows evenly spaced grid on TRANSPARENT background, landscape 1536x1024. No text, no labels, no ground, no shadows, no scenery. Each sprite centered in its equal cell, complete with ample transparent margins. TOP ROW left to right: compact rounded green oak; olive green round egg-shaped birch crown with a short white trunk; compact pine with three softly rounded tiers; ochre acacia with one broad rounded umbrella crown and short forked trunk. BOTTOM ROW: palm with six broad simple curved leaves and a short curved trunk; soft pink cherry tree with three connected round foliage lobes and short trunk; large lilac mushroom with broad rounded dome cap and squat cream stem; compact turquoise/amethyst crystal grove made of three thick blunt geometric crystals with broad clean facets. ART RULES: emulate the very simple comfortable WorldBox tree scale and overhead view in reference. CROWNS occupy 70 percent of the height, trunks only 25 percent. Foliage is ONLY 3 to 5 large continuous rounded shapes in 4 solid colors, top-left pale yellow-green plane, warm midgreen body, muted olive shade under crown. Tree silhouettes almost circular, absolutely NO leafy filigree, NO individual leaves, NO speckles, NO bark grain, NO highlights dots, NO twigs, NO tall realistic proportions, NO airbrush, NO blur, NO glow, NO gradients, NO rich illustration shading. Outer boundary uses broad smooth pixel steps, no bristles. Each asset should read as a friendly tiny rounded toy map object at 32 pixels. Flat limited-color forms, subordinate short trunks. Keep crystal edges thick and few, mushroom a single smooth umbrella with 3 broad shade planes. Make source already simple, NOT a detailed illustration to downsample.

Generate the companion botanical sprite sheet to the attached style reference. Keep EXACTLY its simple rounded pixel shapes, chunky clean light/shadow planes and low-detail 32x40 pixel sprite design. ORIGINAL game art, elevated overhead map camera. This sheet has exactly FOUR COLUMNS by THREE ROWS, each object fully contained centered in one equal cell, with wide empty margins. 1536x1536 square output with a SOLID PURE WHITE background for production extraction; NO checkerboard, NO shadows, NO labels, NO text, NO ground. Top row left to right: soft round domed weeping willow with 4 broad hanging lobes and narrow short trunk; a clump of three thick green bamboo stalks with only a few broad leaves; a squat banana plant with 5 broad arching leaves; a squat green saguaro cactus with 2 round arms. Second row: yellow-green citrus tree with ONE round flattened saucer-like crown, a few broad yellow planes, slender short stem (WorldBox lemon tree feel, no tiny fruit dots); jade tree with three round mint-green gem crowns, a narrow sage stem, 3 large facets per crown; candy tree with three round peach/pink cream puffs on a short narrow caramel trunk, NO tiny sprinkles; bottle tree with plump tan trunk and three small round olive foliage masses. Bottom row: low broad fern clump made of only five clean lobed fronds; low green grass tuft made of five broad rounded blades, no individual thin hairs; low rounded berry bush with 3 leaves masses and ONLY 3 muted red berries; a compact wildflower clump with ONLY three white/yellow flowers and four broad green leaves. Use 4-6 solid colors per material, large connected areas, tiny crisp stepped outline. Round, quiet, friendly and simple. Make trunks SLENDER 2 to 3 pixels wide on a 32-pixel sprite, never fat stumps. All trees have short trunks, crown occupies 70 percent of height. No noisy leaves, no thin spikes, no speckles, no bark grain, no dithering, no gradients, no glow, no glossy rendering. Do not recreate the objects from the input; design the listed companion subjects in that exact low-resolution style.

Make a companion ORIGINAL low-resolution pixel game object sprite sheet matching the attached rounded, quiet pixel-art style. Each sprite designed as simple 32 by 40 pixel art enlarged with nearest neighbour, overhead elevated map camera. Exact FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS grid, landscape 1536x1024. Every object centered and fully inside its equal grid cell with wide whitespace margins. SOLID PURE WHITE background, NO checkerboard, NO shadows, NO labels, NO scenery, no pots. TOP ROW from left: a tiny simple tan seed; a tiny green seedling with one short stem and just two round leaves; a bare little dead tree with a short thin brown forked trunk and only four blunt branches, no thin hairy twigs; a compact cluster of three round slate grey rocks with 3 big flat facets each. BOTTOM ROW from left: two small blue-violet mushrooms with rounded umbrella caps and short cream stems; a low lavender clump with just three broad purple flower spikes and green leaves; a compact cattail reed tuft with three thick rounded green leaves and two brown seed heads; a low succulent/agave rosette of five broad rounded pale green leaves. Flat 4-6-color shape clusters, 3 simple large shade planes. Tiny object at 32 pixels must remain clear and comfortable. No individual leaf veins, no speckle highlights, no scratch texture, no dither, no fine outlines, no filigree, no glow, no blur, no realistic texture. Soft rounded silhouettes with deliberate broad pixel steps. All life stage and groundcover companions must look part of the same game as the reference trees.
